reason: I already learn from TikTok and YouTube for free, and green curry, tom yum and pad see ew are all over there. Paying 99 baht every month for recipes, about two plates of kaprao from the stall, doesn't make sense to me, and the two free dishes are ones I already cook.
objection: My kitchen is tiny and I only have one pan. It says most dishes need one pan, so some don't, and cooking three dishes on Sunday to keep all week is just not happening in a kitchen like mine.
would_change_my_mind: Trying a dish I can't already make, like the green curry, and having it come out better than when I follow a clip, using just my one pan.
